description: Stop ONE tax group charging a rate. The rate itself, its percentages and its use by other groups are untouched — this only drops the link. This is what the merchant means by "remove the city tax from Food". Use delete_tax_rate ONLY when they want the rate gone from the whole company. CONFIRM WITH THE MERCHANT: every product in this group immediately stops being charged this tax. Sales already rung up are NOT recalculated — this only affects sales from now on.
name: hub_remove_tax_rate_from_group
title: Remove rate from group
